sentences.text:
Coram:
 Justice Prathiba M. Singh
 Justice Rajneesh Kumar Gupta
 Order
% 05.05.2025
1.
This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.
2. After some hearing, Mr. Kamal Sawhney, ld. Counsel for the Petitioner submits that he wishes to withdraw the present petition and file an appeal challenging the impugned order.
A period of 30 days is being granted to file the same along with the requisite pre-deposit.
If the same is filed within the stipulated period, the appeal shall be considered on merits and shall not be dismissed on the ground of limitation.
3. Accordingly, petition is dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.
All pending applications, if any, are also disposed of.

PRATHIBA M. SINGH, J.
RAJNEESH KUMAR GUPTA, J.
MAY 5, 2025/Rahul/Ar.
